reviewDescription: If you’re looking for something soft and without pressure/tension around the head, this is the best option on the market. Quality control needs improvement but the headband is worth it — especially if yours arrives properly assembled. I’m generously giving 4 starts because I like the product but it’s not without quirks. Most importantly this is perfect for anyone who has headaches or is sensitive to pressure around the head. It’s loose fitting but in a way that isn’t terrible, especially if you’re laying on your side and can position the ear speaker. This is my fourth headband, first of this brand, and I like this the best outta all of them. The fabric is by far softer and superior to other brands tried. Why this didn’t get 5 stars—- it arrived nearly unusable! The tiny hole for charging did not align with the device port due to the device being upside down and backwards. I had to (with a ridiculously absurd amount of effort) remove the device, orient it the correct way, and then force it back through the headband into an almost too small pouch. It was equivalent to re-threading drawstring pants. This is also the process for taking the device out before washing the headband which is so difficult it’s definitely a deterrent. Since I like the headband so well, I’ll probably seem ripper the device pouch and add Velcro or something for easy access.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on May 30, 2026
